messages:
reba.design: Quick a11y pass on the Models list after the compact row update. Found four small issues: focus, kebab tabbability with virtualization, duplicated SR header, and low-contrast pills. Short repros below.
owen.frontend: thanks  paste steps and I'll take the DOM/ARIA fixes.
mina.a11y: top-level: keep DOM focus aligned with visual selection (roving tabindex), ensure action buttons are tabbable even when virtualized, avoid double announcements from labelledby+th, and bump pill contrast.
reba.design: 1) Arrow nav highlights rows but focus stays on the container; keyboard users lose the visible ring. repro: open Models, Down Arrow x2. suggestion: set tabindex=0 on selected row and call focus(), use :focus-visible.
owen.frontend: noted. will implement roving tabindex and move focus in the key handler.
reba.design: 2) Kebab (More) button is skipped in Tab for many virtual rows; tab order jumps past it until interaction. repro: Tab through list. suggestion: keep a real tabbable control per logical row and mark visual clones aria-hidden.
owen.frontend: virtualization tweak required; I'll keep the kebab node tabbable and hide clones visually.
mina.a11y: 3) SRs sometimes announce the column header twice for the first cell ("Name, Models, Name"). Likely extra aria-labelledby. Remove redundant labelledby and use aria-describedby for extra info.
owen.frontend: will audit and remove unnecessary labelledby refs.
reba.design: 4) Status pills (experimental/deprecated) read faint at small sizes (~2.6:1). Suggest new tokens --status-pill-text/bg or semi-bold text to reach >=3:1 (4.5:1 preferred).
owen.frontend: I'll propose token swaps and screenshots in a small PR.
jo.qa: I'll add E2E tests: tab-order across 12 rows, kebab aria-label per-row, and a VO smoke test for header announcements.
mina.a11y: tiny copy nit: kebab aria-label should be contextual: `aria-label="More actions for ${model.name}"`.
owen.frontend: agreed, will set dynamic aria-label. Splitting into two PRs: (A) roving focus + kebab tabbability (P0) in 3 business days, (B) pill tokens + labelledby cleanup (P1) next week.
reba.design: thanks folks  I'll attach token swatches and a short screenshot in the PR thread.
mina.a11y: ping me on PR A for a quick review and I'll add a tiny checklist to the component README.
